messages:
alex: Heads up — planning a compact launch digest for the April benchmark webinar + new blog. Need send windows, segments, and a tiny surge email before the live. Draft campaign doc: https://app.redwood.com/campaigns/compact-launch-apr2026

tara: Saw the draft. Quick priorities: 1) define cohorts (warm trial users vs recent signups vs cold), 2) subjectline A/B on holdout slice, 3) timezone-staggered sends to protect deliverability.

sam: Recommend subject test on 20% of each cohort (50/50). For send windows propose NA morning, EMEA late morning, APAC morning local. Keep batches small to avoid spikes.

mike: I’ll pull baseline open/CTR for those cohorts. FYI last quarter warm cohort CTR ~14%. I’ll share a quick table by EOD.

olivia: Updated hero + CTA copy. Variant A uses "Benchmark wins: 2x latency & cost" and Variant B leans into case study. Preview assets: https://cdn.redwood.com/assets/compact-launch-previews

alex: Can we also do a 1-hour-before-webinar micro-surge to high-intent signups? Short 1‑line reminder, single CTA to join. Also add suppression for anyone who opened any email in last 7 days.

tara: @sam can you own orchestration? @mike you own tracking and reporting? I’ll handle copy QA and calendar.

sam: Happy to own orchestration. Segments I’ll create: 1) trial_active_7d, 2) signups_30d, 3) engaged_cold_90d. Stagger windows as discussed. I’ll push segments to test workspace and run a small seeded send. Send script snippet I’ll use:

```
send_window = {
  "NA": "2026-04-15T09:00:00-07:00",
  "EMEA": "2026-04-15T10:00:00+01:00",
  "APAC": "2026-04-15T10:00:00+08:00"
}
```
I’ll keep batch throttle to 500/min for the initial wave.

mike: Add UTMs: utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=compact_launch_apr2026. I’ll wire tracking and set a dashboard tile for first-hour metrics.

ops-bot: Reminder — global suppression list updated 2026-03-01. Any send will be cross-checked; holds applied automatically if deliverability risk > threshold.

alex: Approving creative direction. Tara — once @sam drops segments can we do a quick QA tomorrow 11am PT with ops + legal?

tara: Yes, will book 11am PT slot and invite ops + legal for a compliance sanity check.

olivia: :thumbsup: final images staged under tag v1.2 in CDN. I’ll also export plain-text version for deliverability.

sam: Segments created and pushed to test workspace. Test send to @alex @tara @olivia completed — check your inboxes.

alex: Received test, looks good. Plan: ship warm cohort on 2026-04-15, cold drip ramp begins 2026-04-20. I’ll update campaign doc and schedule in the console.

mike: I’ll monitor 0–60 min and set alerts for bounce rate >5% or spam complaints >0.1%. Will post first-hour snapshot in this thread.

tara: Final checklist: creative ✅ segments ✅ tracking ✅ suppression ✅ ops scheduling ✅. Move to green once schedule is live in the console.

olivia: :rocket: Good luck team — ping if any last-minute asset updates.

alex: Thanks everyone — will post final schedule link here when it’s in the console. :)
